description: This file defines function prototypes for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) operations with different hashing algorithms (MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512). It serves as a wrapper interface for computing HMACs within the lighttpd project.

methods.name: li_hmac_md5
methods.description: Calculates HMAC using MD5 hash algorithm and outputs a 16-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha1
methods.description: Calculates HMAC using SHA1 hash algorithm and outputs a 20-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha256
methods.description: Calculates HMAC using SHA256 hash algorithm and outputs a 32-byte digest.

methods.name: li_hmac_sha512
methods.description: Calculates HMAC using SHA512 hash algorithm and outputs a 64-byte digest.
